app_fee.value: The Graduate School of Arts & Sciences PhD application fee is $95.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School does not give fee waivers to international applicants; you must ask your program directly, and some departments (e.g. Chemistry, Biology) may grant one.
fee_waiver.quote: The central admission office of the Graduate School does not offer application fee waivers to international applicants.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: many of our PhD programs no longer require the GRE General Test, while others have suspended the requirement for applicants

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 5.0 on the new 1-6 scale for tests taken on or after 21 January 2026 (100 of 120 for older tests). Engineering and CDS programs have their own rules.
toefl_min.quote: 5.0 or higher Total Score (on a scale from 1-6) for test taken on or after January 21, 2026. | 100 Overall Score (on a scale from 0-120) for test taken on or before January 20, 2026.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall; General Training, UKVI and Online are not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7.0 Overall Band Score. IELTS Academic test only.

english_waiver.value: A degree from India taught only in English can waive the test, but the transcript must state English is the sole language of instruction (or you upload an institution letter) and you must email the Graduate School to have it reviewed.
english_waiver.quote: your transcript must clearly state that English is the sole language of instruction of your program | you must provide an official letter from the institution confirming that English is the sole language of instruction of the program

notes: Applies to Graduate School of Arts & Sciences (GRS) PhDs. The College of Engineering and the Faculty of Computing & Data Sciences admit their own PhD students under separate rules (see program records).
